title: Horror
story: Playful haunted-house scares for a cozy movie night.

cards.name: Bat
cards.subject: A flying bat with wings spread wide in a symmetrical pose, two pointed ears, a small round body and scalloped wing edges.
cards.hero_colors: charcoal black, small yellow eyes

cards.name: Jack-o-Lantern
cards.subject: A round orange pumpkin with ribs, a short green stem and a carved grinning face with triangle eyes, glowing yellow from inside, standing on wooden porch planks.
cards.hero_colors: orange, green stem, yellow inner glow

cards.name: Cauldron
cards.subject: A round black iron cauldron with a wide rim, two side handles and three short legs, filled with bubbling green potion with a few bubbles rising.
cards.hero_colors: black iron, bright green potion, small gold band on rim

cards.name: Witch Hat
cards.subject: A black witch hat with a wide round brim, a tall pointed cone tip slightly bent, and a band around the base with a square buckle.
cards.hero_colors: black, orange band

cards.name: Haunted Door
cards.subject: A tall arched wooden door with black iron hinges and a round iron knocker ring, set in a grey stone wall, with a small glowing wall lantern bolted above it.
cards.hero_colors: brown wood, grey stone, black iron, warm yellow lantern glow
cards.backdrop_colors: royal blue night sky with a few small stars and a crescent moon
